name: codeguru-reviewer
description: This section provides documentation for the Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer API operations.

subcommands.name: associate-repository
subcommands.description: Use to associate an Amazon Web Services CodeCommit repository or a repository managed by Amazon Web Services CodeStar Connections with Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer.

options.name: --repository
options.description: The repository to associate

options.name: --client-request-token
options.description: Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer uses this value to prevent the accidental creation of duplicate repository associations if there are failures and retries

options.name: --tags
options.description: An array of key-value pairs used to tag an associated repository.

options.name: --kms-key-details
options.description: A KMSKeyDetails object that contains: The encryption option for this repository association.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
